name: corner of Christian Quarter Rd and St Helena Rd (south side of the upper step run)

notes.method: Christian Quarter Rd souq profile by hand (the street is layer -1 in OSM, so make_spec's SOUQ_STREETS profile never reaches it; see the profile requests): closed dukkan openings ~2.0-2.6 x 2.8-3.2 m between rough piers, teal panelled steel doors with padlock bars, a few olive and green roll-down shutters, raised thresholds, timber/steel shed canopies at 2.9-3.6 m on green hoop brackets projecting 1.3 m (street 4-5 m wall to wall). Notes 1.2; B03, B05 (all shops closed), B06. Upper floors left to the rules.
notes.st_helena: Edge 6 (21.3 m, faces N onto the upper St Helena step run): closed shops with olive-green and royal-blue steel doors behind raised stone platforms 0.35-0.45 m high and 0.8-1.0 m deep (C06), no canopies (the street has steel slats overhead, C04). The street drops 3.3 m along this edge and openings sit at the midpoint ground, so only the middle 3 shops (+-3.2 m, within +-0.5 m of the street) are built (request in the profile).
